nl: Which files changed between the tags v0.9 and v1.0? List their paths.

setup.description: A Git repository with the tags v0.9 and v1.0 and one commit after v1.0.
setup.bash:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
printf '%s' '# site-3
' > 'README.md'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v1'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 1
' > 'src/util.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
git tag v0.9
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v2'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
mkdir -p 'docs' && printf '%s' 'new
' > 'docs/new-3.md'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Version 2'
git tag v1.0
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 9
' > 'src/util.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'After release'
setup.pwsh:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'README.md'), '# site-3
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v1'')
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 1
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
git tag v0.9
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v2'')
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'docs' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'docs/new-3.md'), 'new
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Version 2'
git tag v1.0
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 9
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'After release'

oracle_program: git.diff "." from: "v0.9" to: "v1.0" stat: true |> select path
